card.name: Linking words inside serious liver and kidney warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, for, been, in, some, of, with) in the middle of warning sentences about severe harm, mostly liver injury, fetal kidney problems or hepatitis. Also the end of 'Salmonella' in a mutagenicity test.

modes.label: Linking word in liver warnings
modes.description: A small word such as 'been', 'of' or 'or' inside a sentence about fatal or severe liver injury.
modes.example: hepatic failure have<< been>> reported with NSAIDs.

modes.label: Pregnancy kidney warning
modes.description: The words 'in' and 'some' in 'in some cases' after oligohydramnios.
modes.example: oligohydramnios and,<< in>> some cases, neonatal renal impairment.

modes.label: End of Salmonella
modes.description: The last piece of the bacterium name in Ames test descriptions.
